pr_body:
Similar to the _search API, ESQL should support the preference parameter.

Closes #106273
pr_comments: Hi @dnhatn, I've created a changelog YAML for you.
I have fixed the `testProfile` without the preference parameter. I am closing this PR without merging as we are considering another option for the reference parameter.
